difficulty_definitions.easy: Explicit drug identity, direct wording, one evidence section.
difficulty_definitions.medium: Paraphrase, abbreviation, lexical variation or multiple attributes within a topic.
difficulty_definitions.hard: Safety qualifiers, multiple constraints or evidence across sections; no clinical inference.

evaluation_unit: document-section; results deduplicated by document and section
limitations: Draft span rules establish source presence, not independent expert relevance.
Qrels are incomplete: unjudged sections are treated as nonrelevant for provisional scoring.
Section-level scores do not establish that a retrieved chunk contains the answer.
Brand/generic variation is limited to aliases actually present; no unverified ontology maps.
